meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Wix: looping page videos and scroll-to-top button, plus image and footer controls (phone UA capture, desktop not captured)
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13 on www.wix.com with an iPhone UA (390x844), logged out, headless Chrome; the rendered DOM was saved and counts were taken on it. The desktop capture failed (the machine ran out of memory), but Wix serves one responsive page, so the desktop was not separately checked and only real.html (phone) exists as a real fixture. www.wix.com is itself a Wix-built site: its CSS classes are hashed, so the rules use the stable Wix platform markers `wixui-*`, `#WIX_FOOTER`, `#SCROLL_TO_TOP`.

LIVE counts: `.wixui-video-box` 18, `#SCROLL_TO_TOP` 1, `.wixui-image img` 69 (all `data-testid="imageX"` images), `.wixui-image` 69, `#WIX_FOOTER` 1. The recipe matches only `*.wix.com`; sites built with Wix on `wixsite.com` or a custom domain are not matched, so the Wix free-site ad banner (`#WIX_ADS`) is out of scope. The original generic rules matched nothing here and are kept.

NOT verified: the Wix editor and dashboard (manage.wix.com), support and blog subdomains, desktop-only layout differences, logged-in state. The footer rule also removes the footer's social links.
